translations.web: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
translations.bsb: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
translations.kjv: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
translations.asv: But unto us God revealed them through the Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
